object.description: With the document and three-rule file of the previous test case (the second and third rules each name type Requirement and has-outgoing-link): (a) remove the requirement's link and rationale, and validate; (b) starting again, keep the link, remove the requirement's rationale, and validate. In (b) the heading, which has no rationale and no outgoing link, matches the second rule's has-outgoing-link but not its type. Expected: (a) RULE_REQUIRED_MISSING, since both names of the second rule match; (b) neither RULE_REQUIRED_MISSING nor RULE_FORBIDDEN_PRESENT, since the second rule doesn't apply to the heading.
